name: LeWM Experiment1 - AP runtime v0.1.0
desc: LeWM/AP runtime: Python 3.11.14, PyTorch 2.7.1, CUDA 12.6.3, AP and OSMesa, direct SSH. Private GHCR pull credentials required at launch.
readme: LeWM_Experiment1 runtime v0.1.0, pinned by image digest. AP source is in /opt/ap-reference/code/ap and Python in /venv/main. CUDA and headless rendering validated on an RTX 4090. Supply private GHCR pull credentials at launch; no token is stored in this template. Startup does not download research assets or start experiments. Rental shutdown is manual.
env: -e WORKSPACE=/workspace -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 -e OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 -e MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 -e MUJOCO_GL=osmesa -e PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=osmesa -e GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe -e LP_NUM_THREADS=1 -e SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy -e PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT=1 -e HF_HOME=/workspace/LeWM_Experiment1/cache/huggingface
